name: Nehemiah McCary
strengths: McCary diagnoses inside zone early — fills the A-gap with no false steps and finishes TFLs in the backfield.
McCary chases sideline-to-sideline — scrapes over trash and closes from behind with rare range for 6-3 / 220.
McCary finishes through contact and bursts off the edge on green-dog pressure with dip-and-rip speed.
weaknesses: McCary still bites early in zone drops — turns hips too soon on play-action and can lose the crosser behind him.
comparison: McCary comps to Justin Flowe — 6-2/6-3 downhill LB mold with sideline range, tackle violence, and blitz burst while coverage fluidity is still catching up.
projection: McCary projects as a Year 2 SEC starter at linebacker (special teams Year 1). Ceiling: every-down SEC LB — the Maplesville downhill trigger with range who cleans up coverage.
schemeFit: McCary fits Brad White's front as a Will/Sam who can fill downhill, chase, and blitz while developing zone eyes.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-08-10 from On3 Hudl sophomore embed. Comp size-matched within ~1–2" — not a Florida-alum default. Two Gainesville visits on file per board intel.
recruitingStory: Nehemiah McCary is a 4-star LB · listed 6-3 / 220 · Maplesville (AL) — Alabama/Auburn/Florida early standouts; two UF visits including June; HS coach tie to Myles Johnson.
angle: Maplesville LB trigger + chase; Florida pressing despite Alabama dream-school narrative.
insiderNotes: McCary is a downhill LB who fills clean, chases with range, and finishes violent. Coverage depth is the polish item. Florida has visited twice and likes its standing even with Alabama heavy on the RPM.
